prts-65066.text: Tachanka sees first-hand how Ursus uses the Infected as an excuse to exploit villagers who are too weak to fight back. After witnessing this, he is no longer able to stand on the sidelines.

prts-66051.text: The year is 1030. Theresa and Theresis visit the Scar Market to prepare for the founding of the 'Military Commission'. Theresa mentions her dream of building Babel again.

prts-66052.text: Theresa and Theresis convene the Royal Court sovereigns to formally establish the Military Commission. Meanwhile, with Kal'tsit's aid, Babel also begins its operations.

prts-66053.text: In 1068, a Leithanian Kurfürst locates the nomadic city of Kazdel. The Sarkaz rally under the Military Commission to defend their home against the impending crisis.

prts-66054.text: In 1086, as tensions between Babel and the Military Commission escalate, Ascalon chooses her side.

prts-66055.text: Kazdel charges into a Catastrophe to escape pursuit. Theresis takes in a girl from the wastes and names her Ascalon. A boy named Manfred approaches Theresa and Theresis.

prts-66056.text: The ideological conflict between the Sarkaz of Kazdel finally escalates beyond control. Theresa leaves Kazdel with her supporters.

prts-66057.text: The Doctor leaves Babel to learn more about Terra and rescues a child by the name of Amiya.

prts-66058.text: The Doctor takes Amiya back to Babel and decides to help her and the other Infected as part of Babel. Theresa shows the Doctor the 'hope' that she has created through Originium.

prts-66059.text: Theresis receives an invitation from a Victorian duke. Babel's conflict with the Military Commission breaks out into full-scale war, bringing an end to two centuries of peace in Kazdel.

prts-66060.text: The Doctor begins to understand the rules of Terran warfare, and witnesses the disintegration of an Infected for the first time.

prts-66061.text: The Doctor tries to develop new Oripathy medicine through self-experiments. Theresa senses the internal conflict in the Doctor's mind.

prts-66062.text: The supporters of Theresa, fighting for the ideals of Babel, perform spectacularly in the war. The balance tilts towards Babel.

prts-66063.text: The Doctor makes the ultimate choice between the civilization of the past and the present. At a place unknown to any others, the Doctor meets with Theresis.

prts-66064.text: After many years, Theresis finally prepares for his departure to Londinium. Ascalon attempts to stop him, to no avail. Theresa believes in the future of Babel.

prts-66065.text: As the war approaches its end, Babel's landship is stripped of all its defenses, and the assassins targeting Theresa flood in.

prts-66066.text: On the eve of victory, the unexpected happens. Theresa is made aware of the Doctor's chaotic thoughts.

prts-66067.text: As Theresis shifts the strategic focus to Victoria, the civil war reaches its final moments. The Doctor draws up one final plan to retake Kazdel, and Babel's victory is close at hand.

prts-66068.text: Theresa is gravely wounded. She uses the last of her strength to bestow the Civilight Eterna on Amiya. At this moment, the Doctor appears before her.

prts-66069.text: Theresa decides to wipe the Doctor's memories in her final moments. Within the endless memories, she finds that unexpected figure.

prts-66070.text: In 1090, after making meticulous preparations, Kal'tsit and Theresa finally awaken the Doctor, who for the first time makes direct contact with the civilizations of Terra.

prts-66071.text: Theresa is murdered by the assassins. The Banshees sing their dirge for the 'King of Sarkaz'. At death's door, Kal'tsit races back to Theresa's side, only to find everything long over.

prts-66072.text: Theresa sees everything in the Doctor's memories, and finally completes her farewell to that particular person.

prts-66073.text: After the Volsinii incident, Lavinia temporarily takes in Luna, Rubio's daughter... but the girl's condition worries her...

prts-66074.text: A Rhodes Island cafeteria operator wishes to go to Siracusa to see a concert, but Lunacub is the only one available to guide him.

prts-66075.text: Spuria has modified Fortuna's gun according to her wishes. The gun, meant to bring joy, is fired for the first time in a moment of sorrow.

prts-66076.text: Plant hunter Verdant discovers a plant he's never seen before. To protect its existence, he plunges into the sea of flames...

prts-66077.text: What has happened has happened. Kal'tsit rushes back to Babel, but it is too late. Through the already crowned Amiya, Theresa elaborates on her ultimate ideal to Kal'tsit.

prts-66685.text: Things take an unexpected turn as sinister red clouds above the Shard cover the entire battlefield. Meanwhile, Manfred prepares to reclaim the Lifebone.

prts-66687.text:
Siege receives intelligence on the Duke of Caster from Trilby Asher, which helps the Rhodes Islanders understand the battlefield and devise their battle plans.
The Exemplars and Rhodes Island join forces to stop the Military Commission from bringing the complete descent of Amnannam.

prts-66688.text: The Rhodes Islanders search for the Blood of Teekaz, a key influence on Amnannam, only to find themselves greeted by familiar faces and chased down by a Sudaram.

prts-66689.text: Led by Siege, the Exemplars arrive in Gibsonham, where Horn and Bagpipe reunite. Their reunion is abruptly interrupted by an unexpected visitor: the Duke of Gododdin.

prts-66690.text: The Duke of Gododdin invites Siege and the Exemplars to act on behalf of Parliament, but Siege remains distrustful. Meanwhile, Closure detects a legion of Nachzehrers.

prts-66693.text: After defeating the strange monsters with her mercenaries, W enters the Confessarius ruins alone. Meanwhile, a captured Ulšulah finds an opportunity and escapes from Hoederer.

prts-66694.text: W, Hoederer, and the others defend the Lifebone crash site, but W's mercenaries vanish in the unfamiliar environment. While searching for them, W and her team are attacked by strange monsters.

prts-66695.text: Thanks to timely reinforcements from other Rhodes Islanders, Closure sets up signal towers, restoring communications. Meanwhile, the Exemplars and Gododdin's forces successfully defend the town of Gibsonham.

prts-66697.text: W hears Theresa's echo, and finally accepts that Theresa has joined the myriad souls. She lays down her burden and prepares to truly face Theresa.

prts-66698.text: Manfred's troops approach Lifebone with Ulšulah's help. W engages Qalid'čoa and unexpectedly learns the truth of Theresa's rebirth.

prts-66699.text: The Royal Court's troops attack Lifebone. W makes an explosive entry and meets up with Ines. Manfred sneaks into Lifebone and deals Hoederer a mortal blow.

prts-66701.text: In the ducal alliance camp, Siege finds the Victorian soldiers ill-prepared for the drastically different battlefield conditions. Meanwhile, the Nachzehrer King enters the warzone to personally lead his army.

prts-66702.text: The Exemplars meet the enemy on the battlefield. The Duke of Caster receives news that Siege has brought the Realmblade to the front lines. Dublinn's forces, led by Eblana, join the battlefield, and the duel between the Duke of Wellington and the Nachzehrer King begins.

prts-66703.text: The Rhodes Island group follows the trail of the Blood of Teekaz and makes their way to a Confessarius altar set up on the battlefield. However, they find themselves intercepted by Salus, and a number of strange creatures.

prts-66704.text: Amiya and the Doctor confront and defeat Salus once more, and the company chases after Salus' route of escape in search of the Blood of Teekaz.

prts-66707.text: The Stone of the Sword and the Realmblade become one, temporarily dispelling the Originium storm scourging the battlefield. Morale uplifted, the Victorian alliance begins their counterattack. Logos stays behind to hold back the Sudaram, and prepares to face the Nachzehrer King alone.

prts-66708.text: The warship carrying the Stone of the Sword – the Gloriana – is besieged by the Sarkaz. To preserve the glimmer of victory, Siege, assisted by her companions, charges towards the Gloriana with Realmblade in hand.

prts-66709.text: The Nachzehrer King receives an aid request from the battlefield's rear, and decides to withdraw from the front lines to attend to the matter personally. The Duke of Wellington also carries out an action that runs contrary to his plan. The battle situation immediately shifts, and the Duke of Caster's warship, the Gloriana, is crushed in an instant.

prts-66710.text: Logos recreates Theresis's swordsmanship with witchcraft, cutting off the Nachzehrer King's arm. He falls off the cliff in the process, but is saved by a combat platform imbued with the Banshee's will.

prts-66711.text: Logos fights the Nachzehrer King and rings his own death knell.

prts-66712.text: Shining honors her own promise before the Confessarii, and prepares to bring Nightingale back. The Followers' final member, Margaret, finally makes it to her friends.

prts-66714.text: Under Theresa's control, the airship seems to be on a collision course with Amnannam. W and Doctor's team board the airship in a bid to stop Theresa and Amnannam's plan.

prts-66715.text: Shining and Margaret repel the Confessarius at the cost of shattering Nightingale's soul, and his servant Qalid'čoa carries him to safety. At the same time, Salus uses her own blood to boil the Blood of Teekaz.

prts-66716.text: The boarding party's plans aboard the airship are disrupted by the revenant, with the team separated from one another. W saves the Doctor from falling, while Kal'tsit is trapped by herself.

prts-66718.text: In a bizarre team-up, the Doctor and W continue looking for the airship's core, only to find an enemy who looks particularly similar to the assassin who murdered Theresa years ago. Now, they are on the Military Commission's side.

prts-66721.text: Amiya overcomes Babel's enemies from the past, and hurries over to the Doctor and W. Kal'tsit also successfully breaks free and reunites with the group. Amiya sees the revenant's entire life and prepares for a final showdown.

prts-66722.text: W aids Amiya in confronting the revenant, and successfully dismantles its core. The airship begins to go out of control as it loses power, and the wrathful revenant has no further misgivings about attacking everyone in the team.

prts-66723.text: Taking the opportunity of the airship's crystallization, the Doctor works with W to break through the enemy blockade and find the core of the airship. But there is no Theresa here, only the revenant.

prts-66724.text: Theresa finally shows as the revenant dissipates, rescuing it and entering an unknown space.

prts-66725.text: The Doctor leaves that mysterious place, only to appear in Rhodes Island, surrounded by unexpected companions.

prts-66726.text: The Doctor awakens in an unknown space, accompanied by Priestess.

prts-66727.text: Within the Assimilated Universe stands a great tower that touches the sky, and everyone believes that Theresa awaits them at the top. Rhodes Island carries everyone to the tower, and Logos stays behind to face the will of the myriad souls alone.

prts-66728.text: The team encounters the rescued revenant at the top of the tower. It tells them of Theresa's ambition, and Theresa appears with awe-inspiring presence.

prts-66729.text: The inevitable battle begins. It's a battle between W and Her Highness, and also between Amiya and the Sarkaz King she once admired.

prts-66730.text: Everyone walks along the path to the top of the tower that touches the sky. When they arrive at the peak, heaven and earth invert.

prts-66733.text: The past and the future. Theresa catches a glimpse of the answer to life in the Originium's sea of information.

prts-66734.text: Theresa is defeated, but completes her final mission. For a moment, every Sarkaz senses the thorough dissipation of the myriad souls. The Doctor and Amiya bring everyone out of the Assimilated Universe.

prts-66736.text: The assembled Exemplars confirm their next objective: The Shard. Rhodes Island has formulated their strategy for an Londinium assault. The Lifebone takes flight only to crash land because of a strange environmental interference.

prts-66737.text: Amiya prevents the airship from crashing, and sees something unexpected. Theresis also obtains the Sarkaz's Originium that Theresa gave her life for.

prts-66738.text: Back in Londinium, the workers begin working with Reunion. Amnannam descends upon the pinnacle of the Shard. Lifebone takes flight, picking up Amiya and the others.

prts-66739.text: Aroma receives invitations from various Rhodes Island departments. Thanks to her day-to-day work, she discovers a hidden crisis aboard Rhodes Island which influences her decision.

prts-66740.text: In the wake of Theresa's assassination, a group of Sarkaz who no longer walk with Rhodes Island prepare to ambush the landship on a route that it must pass through in order to stop it. However, Ascalon finds them.

prts-66741.text: After the battle at Silverrock Bluffs, Siege and the others once again discover the tracks left by the Steam Knight. She reminisces about the person who once discussed the meaning of 'duty' with her and how his golden mane shone when they were having a stroll.

prts-66742.text: After escaping from the Confessarius, Shining, with Nightingale in tow, seeks shelter from the rain. The two of them have a good time playing with the homeowner's daughter. Shining dispatches the assassins that had been sent after them, and the two pass by Nearl as they prepare to leave after the rain stops.

prts-66744.text: A Catastrophe Messenger visits the anchored Rhodes Island, delivering news that a Catastrophe will strike the area in three to five days. He then approaches GreyThroat and makes her an unexpected offer.

prts-68484.text: Skadi and Specter take the Doctor around the city. Consul Clementia meets with Gladiia in private. Irene encounters the Sea Patrol and assists with the investigation of a missing data scientist.

prts-68485.text: The Iberian mission and the Abyssal Hunters arrive at the underwater city of Milliarium. Jordi and Irene find themselves in a strange environment and civilization.

prts-68487.text: Irene accompanies Secunda in the investigation of a missing data scientist. Meanwhile, Gladiia faces the tribunal at the Sophontheatrum to address the irregularities surrounding the Abyssal Hunters. In the midst of it all, Ulpianus quietly appears by the Doctor's side.

prts-68488.text: Gladiia proves the innocence of the Abyssal Hunters with the help of their former technical advisor Blandus, but suspicions around Ulpianus remain.

prts-68490.text: Secunda and Irene uncover that the disappearance of the data scientist may be linked to the Church of the Deep. When a squadron sent to place a beacon at a Seaborn nest is attacked, the Abyssal Hunters launch a rescue mission.

prts-68492.text: To help the Abyssal Hunters recover quickly, Advisor Blandus once more performs surgery on them after many years, but the Church attacks soon after. Meanwhile, Secunda encounters Ulpianus outside the data scientist's refuge. The scientist left behind some final clues, but had already become a Seaborn.

prts-68493.text: Secunda and Irene trace the data scientist's path to the city's previous stop, only to discover she is likely dead. The squadron sent to deploy the beacon was destroyed, and the Abyssal Hunters save only a few survivors.

prts-68494.text: Secunda learns unexpected details about the missing data scientist, shedding new light on the case. The battlefield situation has suddenly shifted, and despite their lingering doubts, the three Abyssal Hunters become part of the Waterway Program at Consul Clementia's behest, formally joining the battle.

prts-68496.text: Secunda interrogates a Cultist who attacked the lab. After their surgery, the Hunters leave the city. Ulpianus tells the Doctor more about the operation that first slew Ishar'mla.

prts-68497.text: The Doctor shows up at the Abyssal Hunter Lab and maneuvers around Advisor Blandus to uncover what the Church is plotting with the Waterway Program, while helping Ulpianus infiltrate the lab for his own investigation.

prts-68499.text: With the Legions providing cover, the Abyssal Hunters penetrate into the nest to plant the final beacon. Ulpianus continues his search for the truth, while the Doctor finds Consul Clementia and grills her on Ægir's plans for the Hunters.

prts-68501.text: In Milliarium, Ulpianus breaks into the control room in the beacon tower. Confronting the once-loyal friend who now seeks 'symbiosis' with the Seaborn, Ulpianus sentences him.

prts-68502.text: The Seaborn infiltrate the beacon tower. Mutation erupts throughout the city. Consul Clementia pulls the entire population together to respond to the cataclysm and escorts the Doctor and Kal'tsit to the port. However, they run into an unexpected enemy: a fully Seaborn-assimilated Ægir; a researcher of prehistoric civilization who went missing centuries ago.

prts-68503.text: The mysterious Seaborn descends on the city. Kal'tsit and the others learn of the Church of the Deep's origins, and more of the truth behind the Seaborn. Gladiia hastens for the city, but fails to save Ulpianus. He has already separated the tower-turned-nest from the city, and sunk with it into the abyss.

prts-68505.text: Milliarium's remaining city units reorganize themselves into a great wall, stopping the tide of Seaborn coursing towards land. The Waterway Program may have failed, but Ægir's Waterways open up once more in an unprecedented manner.

prts-68507.text: Milliarium reconnects with Ægir's home territories. Gladiia's mother uses a remote connection to discuss an alliance between land and sea with Consul Clementia and Kal'tsit, but the outcome is by no means satisfactory. The mysterious Seaborn meets Skadi before its departure—a meeting between the two 'Ishar'mla's.

prts-68508.text: Jordi helps Ulpianus send a warning to the Abyssal Hunters from the tower. Their beacon planted, the Hunters are ready to return when they are swarmed. Meanwhile, above the tower, the Seaborn begin to seep into the city through the dome.

prts-68509.text: Milliarium, an Ægirian city, takes the initiative in contacting land, inviting envoys from Iberia to the sea. In order to resolve the Seaborn issue, Ægir plans to open a Waterway to connect the ocean and dry land. At the same time, Ulpianus appears in a nearby stretch of sea.

prts-68511.text: Helena hitches a ride to the frontier office. Someone is in a rush, while someone else wants her to slow down.

prts-68512.text: Deepcolor receives a painting and begins a searching journey, following the painting's clues.

prts-68513.text: The connection between Lucilla and a Church of the Deep cultist has made her the target of strict Sea Patrol monitoring, but nobody expects what she does next.

prts-68514.text: Ægir broadcasts their declaration across the entire continent of Terra. Ulpianus intercepts the Seaborn, the formal researcher of the prehistoric civilization. To discover the truth, and to save Ægir, they perhaps will truly walk together.

prts-68516.text: Lutonada follows the voices echoing in her mind, and pieces together three once happy lives.

prts-69164.text: Within the Soul Furnace of Kazdel, a ceremony meant to placate the revenants instead incites their anger. The airship fires its cannons at the Furnace, and fireworks light up the night sky. Nymph, doing her best to look after a furnace node, picks up a talking firework fragment, and in doing so takes on a special task.

prts-69165.text: Nymph visits 'the Consultant' Pohl's district in search of the revenant pieces. The gangs are fighting over a meteor and are on the verge of pulling blades. With Pohl's help, Nymph recovers the revenant fragment inside the meteor, and Pohl takes the opportunity to resolve a crisis.

prts-69166.text: A monster has been attacking passersby near some abandoned shacks. Nymph and Pohl investigate the hauntings and discover that it is a colossus made by Mudrock. Mudrock removes the Arts binding the colossus, and Nymph retrieves the revenant fragment that caused it to go berserk.

prts-69167.text: In a Sarkaz marketplace, the unconventional Crownie catches Nymph's eye. She has fashioned a revenant fragment into a gemstone brooch to go with her suit. Nymph follows her out of the city, and runs into Mostima on a delivery. After improving the design of another suit, Crownie finds she no longer needs the brooch, and gives it to Nymph.

prts-69168.text: In search of a place where she can truly be happy, Caper arrives in Dossoles only to find that the word 'happiness' has a whole different meaning in this so-called 'City of Pleasure'.

prts-69169.text: City guard Ambriel is assigned to watch over one of the Holy City's walls but repeatedly finds Laterans who challenge the rules in the name of freedom.

prts-69170.text: Having returned to Kazdel, the Tin Man finds himself mistaken by Nymph and Pohl for being in possession of a revenant fragment. With Ermengarde's help, the gang enters the deepest depths of the Soul Furnace and returns all the fragments, then attempts a different kind of ceremony of appeasement. However, the Tin Man and the other revenants have other plans.

prts-69171.text: One day, Harold's prosthetic leg gets trampled by a burdenbeast. He decides to seek Rhodes Island's assistance in getting it repaired.

prts-69172.text: Nymph and Pohl split up to investigate the last residential district. Along the way, Nymph visits Qalaiša, the Northwind Witch, who has recently moved in. While Qalaiša is away, Nymph becomes trapped in a strange dream of the witch's past. In her efforts to retrieve the revenant fragment, she accidentally destroys Qalaiša's hut.

prts-69173.text: Warmy returns to her hometown and enjoys an outdoor movie with the members of the community. The story's ending remains untold, but she wants to put an end to it all.

prts-70402.text: Pepe examines the reanimated Nameless General in the office, while Narantuya proceeds with her kidnapping plan. Medjehtiqedti encounters 'supernatural events' while evacuating the visitors, and the Minoan tourist Aspasia leads the rest of the visitors out of the museum.

prts-70403.text: When she isn't allowed to borrow an exhibit, Pepe sneaks into the museum at night, placing her gem into the item, only to find it strangely disappears. She is forced to leave when a security guard shows up. The next day, the Nameless General wakes up in the middle of the exhibit.

prts-70405.text: The frightened crowd flees and Anat faints in shock. Medjehtiqedti helps organize the evacuation, while Pepe, knowing the reason for the Nameless General's resurrection, comes up with an idea to move the mummy and the unconscious Anat to the curator's office.

prts-70406.text: Narantuya is stopped and defenestrated by the reanimated mummy. While patrolling the halls, Medjehtiqedti is stunned to discover that other exhibits have begun to move as well. Pepe learns the name of the mummy—Zubayr—in the curator's office.

prts-70409.text: As the Gathering approaches, Pepe gets ready for the event in her own way, aiming for her desired prize. Aspasia, too, is vying for a prize with Narantuya's help. In the museum, Anat and Medjehtiqedti have a disagreement on how to run the museum.

prts-70410.text: At the Harvest Gathering, Pepe realizes that the second-place prize is the gem she is looking for and comes up with a plan to win it. Aspasia recognizes the third-place prize as the other goblet that belonged to her family.

prts-70411.text: Zubayr tells Pepe that he needs three other gems to help her find the treasury, and the pair search the Menat-Ha'mait night. On the other side of the city, Lazvar, overseer of the gem trading post, instructs his pets to locate the gems.

prts-70413.text: At the announcement of the competition results, the first place winner forfeits, leaving Pepe and Aspasia without their desired prizes. Narantuya decides to use the gem Aspasia won as bait for Pepe, but unexpectedly, the gem lands in Medjehtiqedti's hands.

prts-70414.text: To get the gem, Pepe has no choice but to accept Medjehtiqedti's terms, leaving Zubayr behind in the museum to draw in visitors. However, Zubayr is angered by the rude tourists, and leaves after a quarrel with Pepe. He then runs into a distraught Narantuya on the riverbank.

prts-70415.text: Prompted by Narantuya, Lazvar decides to purchase Zubayr. Once the transaction is complete, Lazvar's pets begin to speak and reveal themselves as Sovereigns of Beasts.

prts-70418.text: Zubayr awakens countless constructs to restore the city into the treasure trove he once guarded. He then entrusts the two Sovereigns of Beasts with putting both Narantuya and Pepe through a trial.

prts-70419.text: Pepe is swallowed by Mio at the Great Bazaar. Narantuya encounters Dio in the chaos.

prts-70420.text: Narantuya refuses to embark on her traditional Nightzmoran Khaganquest and is trapped within the illusion, but Aspasia shatters it by chasing Dio away. Pepe awakens to find herself surrounded by sand.

prts-70422.text: Within the illusion, Pepe experiences everything Zubayr went through. She makes the same choice he did, passes the test, and is released by Mio. Inside the museum, Narantuya decides to prevent the city from sinking into the sands.

prts-70425.text: Zubayr brings Pepe to the trove and explains his reasons for guarding it. Though Pepe understands, she must fight him to protect the city. Meanwhile, Narantuya and Aspasia argue over who should undertake the most dangerous part of the plan.

prts-70426.text: In the museum of Menat-Ha'mait, Acting Curator Anat and Vice Curator Medjehtiqedti await an honored guest: Pepe, daughter of the Padishah. Pepe has come with the intent to borrow the museum's crown jewel: the Nameless General. But she is unaware that the desert bandit Narantuya has also arrived in the city following her.

prts-70427.text: Pepe destroys Zubayr's gem and stops the constructs' rampage. The treasure of Narantuya's dreams sinks into the crack beneath the city.

prts-70429.text: Many years later, with the Volcano Watchers' buds she has cultivated, Adele climbs Mount Unna for the first time.

prts-70430.text: For her first task as head of her own crew, Shana chose to complete the project her father had left unfinished.

prts-70431.text: As he hears the Sovereigns of Beasts, Zhubayr finds that they have been awaiting his return. Lazvar also offers him another gem. Now, he recalls his identity and his duty as an attendant general to the Shah charged with guarding the Shah's glorious treasures.

prts-70432.text: Having survived the crisis, it is time for goodbyes and new journeys.

prts-70433.text: Lazvar must find a lost auction item as the Great Bazaar Auction draws near.

prts-70435.text: Upon settling near Kazdel, the Mudrock Squad expressed a common wish: they want some beer.

prts-70436.text: Gertrude extends an invitation to Czerny, in hopes he can perform his recently published Morgen und Abend at a funeral.

prts-70438.text: A teacher—Fischer in disguise—evacuates a group of children from the Sarkaz blockade. Little do they even know, their beloved teacher will never return again.

prts-71570.text: Laios and his party find themselves in a completely foreign area. Never did they imagine that they would immediately be hunted down by a bunch of strange rock slugs and a terrifying armored orc.

prts-71571.text: After the misunderstanding has cleared up, the party learns they are in Big Bob's Originium slug ranch! What do his Originium slug beer and dishes taste like?

prts-71573.text: The party originally plans to seek help from a wise High Priest in the area, but Marcille is unexpectedly overwhelmed by all the new information and accidentally eats a poisonous fruit, sending the tribe into chaos.

prts-71574.text: The other party members plan to attract the mysterious High Priest with a delicious meal to cure Marcille's poisoning, but little did they expect Senshi's carefully chosen 'blue fatty bird' to actually be the very same High Priest they have been looking for the whole time.

prts-71577.text: Chilchuck dreams a strange dream in Sami, and at the same time, the will of Sami also tells Laios's party to head north and keep an eye out for the legendary Cyclopes. What could it all actually mean?

prts-71578.text: Laios's party sets out to find Goldglitter Originium slugs, all to grant the wishes of some factory workers who want to eat golden carrot as their last meal together.

prts-71579.text: Marcille's D32 Steel flashlight can turn the mucus of Acid Originium slugs into an edible, golden ingredient. With this, Senshi manages to satisfy the factory workers, and Laios's party obtains a free ride as payment.

prts-71581.text: Despite observing all of Sami's wonders and being cautious on their journey so far, Chilchuck fails to stop the rest of his party from eating the very strange looking hornbeast, and can only watch as they turn into Collapsals.

prts-71582.text: The party accidentally stumbles into a painting, where they begin to lose their sense of self, slowly merging with the artwork. Amidst the chaos, Laios manages to communicate with the ink spirits that had attacked them, and an unexpected friendship quickly blossoms.

prts-71583.text: Laios, having become well-acquainted with the ink spirits in the mountains, has found a way to make fruit juice, jam, and wine with their help. In doing so, he's also begun to uncover the hidden truths of the painting.

prts-71585.text: The priest's plot is inadvertently foiled by the party, who turn the Seaborn into a grand feast and prepare to venture into the sea for more ingredients. However, their actions only serve to terrify the local residents.

prts-71586.text: The misery of the citizens of Sal Viento stirs Senshi's desire to cook a bounteous feast for them. However, a local priest of the Church of the Deep has other plans. Gazing towards a distant cave overrun by the Seaborn, a scheme comes to mind.

prts-71587.text: Laios's party, thinking they're being attacked. The pioneers, thinking they're getting robbed by the Laios's party. A Rhodes Island operator, just here on a mission. Thanks to a flock of out-of-control drones, these three parties are thrown into a chaotic situation.

prts-71589.text: Initially at odds, the three parties decide to handle the out-of-control drones together. Marcille shows off her talents as one of the most brilliant students in her school's history, leading the drones out into the empty fields—which just happen to be the pioneers' corn fields!

prts-71591.text: In the early days of Karlan Trade, many elders were conservative and disapproved of Enciodes's methods. They attempted to sway Weiss to their side, unaware that this was precisely what Weiss had been waiting for all along...

prts-71593.text: Goldenglow's in Caladon visiting old friends and has a lottery ticket boasting an 80% win rate. As she scratches it open, she promises herself nothing more than a scoop of ice cream if she wins...

prts-71594.text: Mitm's newspaper agency fails to get off the ground, but he manages to get himself a printer. Now he just needs a typesetter who can read.

prts-71595.text: The party finally makes it aboard Rhodes Island by following Ceobe, but before their eyes, she becomes something rather strange...

prts-71596.text: With the crisis averted, the party can finally relax and explore Rhodes Island, cook a feast full of memories, and share it with everyone aboard.

prts-71597.text: Eunectes hurries back to Acahualla after receiving a letter from Inam to begin a construction project. Despite insisting that he would have no part of it, High Priest starts getting involved...

prts-72392.text: Following the close of the war, Speaker Vina must handle the thorny issue of the Sarkaz left behind. But she does not hesitate. The moment she took up the mantle of Speaker, she knew what she would have to face.

prts-72393.text: Soon after the end of the war, Vina determinedly takes up the mantle of Speaker to protect Londinium's citizens, no matter what the dukes demand of her. In the presence, another name is causing her headache: Millscar.

prts-72395.text: Vina received a mysterious gift when the Exemplars broke into the city, confirming for the first time that an old friend had survived.

prts-72396.text: Parliament works to track down Millscar, while Vina understands that she must confront Allerdale, who has chosen another path.

prts-72398.text: Parliament's provisional court puts Millscar on trial for its crimes, but the namesake leader herself forfeits her right to a defense. Vina issues an arrest warrant and orders the neutralization of the organization's members.

prts-72399.text: The reorganized Defense Forces set forth to maintain order in Londinium. Millscar is smuggling Sarkaz out of the city. Vina officiates a memorial service for the fallen innocent.

prts-72400.text: Rumors about the treatment of the Exemplars spreads amongst the rank and file. No one wants Parliament to disband the unit, with their heroic accomplishments. Lieutenant Shearer continues to be plagued by the injuries he suffered during the war.

prts-72402.text: During the war, soldiers fought side-by-side and sang songs together, as they marched towards victory. Today, however, things are not as they have hoped, and Vina is not happy with what she has been able to achieve for the city.

prts-72404.text: The workers have established the Londinium Industry Development Association with parliamentary support following the end of the war. Feist, now acting as its consultant, is active in the development of new technology and assisting with rebuilding. Shortages of resources remain a source of conflict, however.

prts-72405.text: Vina finally decides to represent Parliament by publicly declaring a series of future programs, including one aimed at resettling the Exemplars. Though the sudden and secretive arrival of the dukes in the city alongside the theft of the crown leads to new troubles.

prts-72406.text: The retired soldier who stole the crown willingly appears before Vina, attempting to persuade her to become the king she envisioned. Yet Vina chooses to leave the throne vacant, with the crown resting upon it.

prts-72408.text: Vina has her hands full with the problems of the city. The Glasgow Gang do their best to help in their own way. Delphine appears before Shearer, who continues to suffer from lingering symptoms, and promises to take him back to Lynncardine.

prts-72409.text: The Exemplars, led by Vina, press forward relentlessly after breaking through the blockade at the city walls. Before the final battle, Vina hands the Realmblade to the people. She rallies soldiers, workers, and all manner of city dwellers to storm the Sarkaz's final stronghold together.

prts-72410.text: After the final battle, victory is secured and the Steam Knight's mission is complete. Allerdale bids farewell to Vina before vanishing into the steam. Vina faces the dukes to address Londinium's many issues.

prts-72412.text: Vina bids farewell to the crown stealer who loves Victoria and tells her a tale steeped in ambiguity—how, after the war is won, she declines the coronation offered by the supposedly deceased King Alistair II.

prts-72413.text: Vina confronts the dukes' provocation directly, reclaiming resources for the people of Londinium and formally declaring she will not become king. Meanwhile, the Glasgow Gang returns to Norport.

prts-72414.text: A gang called Glasgow leaves Londinium, and so a tale of Vina Victoria begins.

prts-72415.text: The Glasgow Gang returns home. Here, things are largely the same, but the people have changed. After they bemoan the lack of Vina, Vina shows up by her hungover friends' side. The war is finally over.

prts-72417.text: Noble heir Michael of Lupukarn is summoned to the capital for his 'education.' Despite his modest status, he secures an audience with the intimidating Twin Empresses and strives to gain opportunities for his homeland.

prts-72418.text: Feist helps a factory optimize their production lines, but he never foresaw the possibility that 'optimization' was not always inspirational.

prts-72419.text: During a rescue mission, Absinthe finds herself trapped in a cave-in and must work with Rosa to escape. Unexpectedly, she finds herself confronting the truth behind her partner's seemingly strong convictions.

prts-72420.text: Despite the survival knowledge from her books being of little help in the Sargonian rainforest, Papyrus continues to explore its ecology and tribal history one step at a time.

prts-73211.text: Eirene, president of the Truckers' Union, requested by Judge Lavinia, helps investigate the hit-and-run, only to learn that the culprit is her friend—a truck driver named Sommer. Meanwhile, Lavinia has become suspicious of Demetri, the man who invited Leontuzzo to the banquet.

prts-73212.text: Nuova Volsinii is currently free of mafiosi, but the famiglie have not given up on infiltrating the city. They're trying to use 'companies' to make inroads into the Truckers' Union. Eirene learns that her friend was the one who, while smuggling for the Venezia family, accidentally injured Leontuzzo.

prts-73213.text: Her options dwindling, Eirene decides to go ask Judge Lavinia for help. However, after sitting in on the court proceedings, she changes her mind and gets into a taxi driven by the White Wolf. After returning to Nuova Volsinii, Texas takes out the invitation she got from Lappland.

prts-73214.text: To protect the Truckers' Union, Eirene strikes a deal with Alberto to hand over the truck carrying the famiglie's goods to the Saluzzos. But when the two of them arrive at the place where the truck has been stashed, a giant float suddenly bursts into flames.

prts-73215.text: To find out the truth of how her daughter Suzuran got hurt, a former Famiglia Venezia assassin, Ingrid, accepts a request from a Signore dei Lupi to protect his Fang—an old tailor. The tailor's grandson unexpectedly witnesses a car accident while out on a delivery, and is abducted by Venezia mafiosi.

prts-73216.text: Lavinia pursues Ingrid, but the head of the Venezia Trucking Co, Venezia Junior steps in personally to end the chase. Ingrid refuses his invitation to return to the family, but she then learns from Lappland that the old tailor's grandson is currently being held within the Venezia residence.

prts-73217.text: Lavinia and Demetri meet in a winery. She suspects him of being involved with the accident, but chances upon Ingrid who is asking around about the news, and the two get acquainted. After Ingrid leaves, Lavinia finds out the Vulpo lady was in fact at the scene on that very night.

prts-73218.text: The old tailor learns where his grandson is, and decides to go to the Venezia residence to face Venezia Sr., his former employer. To fulfill her promise to the Signore dei Lupi, Ingrid decides to accompany Umberto and return to the family she left many years ago.

prts-73219.text: After witnessing the tragic death of her master, Lyudmila seeks a way to avenge her by taking down Red, but to no avail. In the end, she collapses in exhaustion out in the wilds, and is brought to the Truckers' Union by Sommer, who accidentally passes by.

prts-73220.text: Lyudmila stays at the Truckers' Union, slowly becoming a part of the truckers' lives. On the night of the car crash, Sommer avoids the other drivers to go out on a drive of his own. Sensing something amiss, Lyudmila sits herself down on his passenger seat.

prts-73221.text: Lyudmila returns to the camp and finds out that Sommer has not returned. Consumed by guilt, she searched for him and eventually arrived at the port, where she discovered weapons smuggled inside the missing truck. To stop the Truckers' Union from getting entangled in more trouble, Lyudmila lights a fire.

prts-73222.text: Out on the wastes, Lappland finds a wrecked taxi and returns to Nuova Volsinii with Zaaro to join in the fun at Carnevale. On the night of the car accident, she witnesses everything unfold from the roof of a high-rise building—a wonderful show is staged and set.

prts-73223.text: The clash between Projekt Red and Lunacub unexpectedly causes a crash between Sommer's truck and Leontuzzo's limo. Facing down Projekt Red once again, the enraged Lyudmila chases her alone.

prts-73224.text: Lappland passes Eirene's case file to Lavinia, who realizes the connection between the truckers and the famiglie, and she takes the initiative to confront the two families in order to stop the situation from spiraling out of control.

prts-73225.text: Venezia Junior finds out about the city hall and court's actions, forces Venezia Senior to 'retire', and decides to take over the city during Carnevale. Eirene finds out that the Truckers' Union has never escaped the famiglia's shadow, and decides to organize the drivers to separate themselves from the mob.

prts-73226.text: A vehicle from the Truckers' Union is what caused the fire, for which Eirene is arrested and put on trial. However, Alberto and Venezia Junior tacitly plead her innocence. Lappland and Texas reunite, witnessing both the port blaze and the entire court hearing.

prts-73227.text: The streets are packed for Carnevale. Masked citizens and floats built in the image of beasts parade through the city. Famiglia Venezia attempts to occupy the courthouse, but find dozens of trucks in their way.

prts-73228.text: The truck drivers are locked in a standoff against the mafiosi. Lappland drives the cargo landship straight into the city and litters the square with Venezia's smuggled weapons, bringing to light what had heretofore been a power struggle under the surface.

prts-73229.text: The old tailor dies before Red's eyes. Ingrid kills the true culprit, Venezia Junior. Lappland and Texas make a bet on whether the parade will arrive to a sea of blood. Both mafiosi and truck drivers grab weapons. Tensions run high when a shot rings out.

prts-73230.text: The two sides in the standoff lay down their weapons, and the parade arrives at Court Square without incident. Lappland hands her mask to Texas, who wins their bet. Leontuzzo arrives at the scene, escorted by Demetri, and gives the closing address.

prts-73231.text: Nuova Volsinii prepares for the Carnevale to celebrate its first anniversary. While City Hall releases a promotional video and citizens prepare masks and costumes, mayor-elect Leontuzzo is caught in a car accident.

prts-73232.text: Emperor and High Priest help repair the floats. Ingrid discovers the identity of the culprit that she is pursuing. The old tailor suggests she leave. Gambino controls the port's dispatch at Venezia Junior's orders, but Lappland shows up.

prts-73233.text: Venezia Senior decides to let the old tailor and his grandson leave as a testament to the famiglia's creed of 'decency'. Ingrid returns the family crest to him, officially leaving the Venezias, and bids farewell to the old Venezia who have treated her as his own daughter.

prts-73234.text: Jieyun wishes to restore the Sword Forge to the way her shifu described it to her: some would spar, some would drink, and everyone knew everyone, joining each other in song. By chance, she meets two drunken martial artists.

prts-73235.text: Lessing and Ebenholz return to Urtica and dedicate themselves to governing it more effectively. Unbeknownst to Lessing, his unique stubbornness will lead to a series of comical absurdities.

prts-73236.text: On Ceylon's birthday, Schwarz intends to handle business as usual before celebrating her lady's special day. However, something unexpected happens that morning—

prts-73237.text: One day, Texas is assigned to deliver a shipment to a concert hall. However, after Texas arrives at the designated location, she soon discovers that the 'goods' to be delivered is actually a person...

prts-73238.text: Totter returns to his hometown to live out his final days in peace, but a series of unfortunate events destroys that peace forever.

prts-73239.text: Venezia Senior pays a hefty price to protect Venezia Trucking. Lyudmila bids farewell to Eirene, after warning her against her hidden thoughts. The Signori dei Lupi game ends, but humanity's power struggles persist as always. Lappland becomes the new alpha.

prts-73240.text: Vigil has a dream. In his dream, he recalls his long-forgotten past.

prts-74391.text: Two weeks ago, Thorns, who had come to Iberia in search of a sword technique, is knocked unconscious by a saltfin, and has an unexpected encounter with Pascuala, who is being chased by a sheriff intent on executing her. After dealing with the Alguacil Anastasio, the pair head to the town of Aarón.

prts-74392.text: Thorns excavates a grave to find the sword technique he seeks, but is mistaken for a grave robber. Pascuala is also caught stealing. As the two are about to be hanged, a gang of bandits rushes the execution grounds, rescuing them and spiriting them away.

prts-74393.text: Thorns refuses to fix the compass for Juana, and it seems the sailors support his decision behind their leader's back. Meanwhile, Elysium and Weedy come to Aarón to find the missing Thorns.

prts-74396.text: Thanks to a lack of supplies, the sailors prepare to take Thorns out saltfin hunting. Juana appears to be hiding some dread secret having to do with the Seaborn.

prts-74397.text: Juana leads the finning team into the Salt Flat to hunt a massive saltfin. Anastasio is waiting on the path of their return.

prts-74398.text: Juana kills the massive saltfin after a deadly battle, but it is taken by Anastasio and Silver in an ambush. The crew barely escapes, and begins to accept Thorns as one of their own.

prts-74401.text: The compass repairs do not go well. The sailors plan a mutiny. Thorns kills the sword-wielding Seaborn under Juana's direction and learns the sword technique that fights the wind and waves.

prts-74402.text: The conflict within the fleet intensifies. Pascuala's golden tongue buys some time, but Thorns's alchemy fails. Javier goes to town to seek a way out for the crew from the Inquisition's persecution.

prts-74418.text: Unrest begins to spread through the camp due to a lack of supplies. Javier wants to surrender to the town with the crew. Anastasio begins to harbor thoughts about Aarón that he should not.

prts-74419.text: Silver and Anastasio disagree over the treatment of the captured crew. Elysium has infiltrated the camp and manages to find Thorns, who has agreed to help Juana repair the compass.

prts-74421.text: Anastasio leads the raid on the pirate camp. Juana lets Thorns go, but he returns when he sees the light from the fire in the distance.

prts-74422.text: After rescuing Juana, Thorns heads to the alchemy lab to retrieve his tools, encountering Anastasio in search of the compass. He escapes by triggering an explosion. The crew then flees toward Skeletal Reef to evade their pursuers.

prts-74424.text: Anastasio musters a party to pursue Thorns and the rest. La Conquista is hit and Thorns puts his hand into an Arts energy field to salvage the collapsing Corazonix.

prts-74426.text: With Anastasio in hot pursuit, Juana has no choice but to steer the ship into the valley of gushing steam. The final showdown looms near.

prts-74427.text: Javier proves to Juana that he can lead the crew towards a different future. Forced into desperate straits in his fight against Anastasio, Thorns leaps into the gushing steam.

prts-74428.text: Thorns cuts through the steam and defeats Anastasio. With the crisis over, the crew decides their respective futures. Juana dances one last time under the sunset.

prts-74431.text: Everyone makes a choice about the future they want. Some sailors choose to return to town with Javier, while others sail out to sea with Thorns and Juana. Pascuala sets off to seek a good life.

prts-74432.text: Thorns resumes his repair work on the compass. The crew flees towards the reef, not knowing what the future holds. Back at town, Silver, who had given his entire life to Aarón, was judged by a resurrected Anastasio as having developed desires he should not have, and is executed.

prts-74433.text: Thorns tries to escape from a group of bandits who have kidnapped him, but unfortunately, he is trussed up once more, and hung upside down from a flagpole as a warning. Within the den of thieves, the bandit leader Juana's crew disapproves of her recent decisions.

prts-74435.text: Courier runs into a dilemma as he tackles Kjerag's logistics issues. SilverAsh appears before him.

prts-74436.text: After the passing of an Oripathy patient, Ceylon receives a heartfelt request from a close friend of the deceased, causing her to realize that she is not truly ready to face the death of a loved one.

prts-74437.text: Rose Salt thought this mission was the chance to live the life of her dreams. Turns out she is getting more than she bargained for.

prts-74438.text: After the club where they hang out is set on fire, Tecno and her artist friends defy their oppressors in their own way.

prts-75508.text: Blaze follows Leizi to Baizao in search of the truth of her origins. As all of Baizao prepares for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, a feeling of unease permeates the city. Blaze visits a small eatery, where she enjoys a familiar dish.

prts-75509.text: Leizi returns to the Judicial Review Office for the trial of Yu Cheng, a former deputy minister of the Office. Yu Cheng has turned himself in, claiming to be the one who burned down the archives in the scrollery. Yu Cheng's strange behavior leads Leizi to believe he may have an ulterior motive. Leizi decides to review old cases that Yu Cheng once investigated.

prts-75511.text: Through deduction, Leizi identifies the person most directly connected to the two old cases—Ning Shu, the retired Minister of Rites. That same day, Liang Xun, the Advisor of Yumen, also appears at Ning's manor.

prts-75513.text: Xingzhu takes Blaze all over Baizao in search of the tangerine cakes she remembers, but they do not find them. Eventually, the Young Chef suggests that Mo Bufu, head chef of Ding Feng Lou, might know how to make them.

prts-75516.text: The Young Chef gives Blaze's longevity noodles his seal of approval. Leizi finds another way to access the Academy's archives, allowing her to take her investigation in a new direction.

prts-75517.text: Blaze is determined to take part in the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies Chef Selection Competition, so the Young Chef starts giving her special culinary training. Unfortunately, her horrid cooking skills give him a real headache. Meanwhile, Xingzhu patiently accompanies Blaze and gives her advice. A bowl of longevity noodles brings back a lot of memories for the two.

prts-75518.text: Blaze goes to Ding Feng Lou to take part in the Chef Selection for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies; coincidentally, Leizi is investigating there. Out of sheer luck, Blaze stumbles her way through the qualifiers and meets Mo Bufu, when the Ding Feng Lou venue suddenly catches fire.

prts-75522.text: Blaze rescues Mo Bufu from the fire, who turns out to be the witness Leizi is after. Just as Leizi seeks to question him, Chen Che of the Judicial Review Office arrives with her force, putting the whole place under lockdown.

prts-75523.text: Blaze is invited to the Ning Manor, where Xingzhu confesses to being a daughter of the Nings, and to having met Blaze's father before. Elsewhere, Jie Zhen finds Leizi, and hints to Leizi that she should stay staunch and see the investigation through to the end.

prts-75524.text: Hundreds of mandarins gather before the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. During this time, the Grand Commandant's Messenger finds Zuo Xuanliao overseeing Yumen. Leizi and Blaze sneak into the Feast, and just as Leizi stands up to remonstrate with the True Lung, a great conflagration overtakes the banquet.

prts-75527.text: Blaze and Leizi meet up again, and the two decide to head to the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. Elsewhere, the time has come for the Yanese imperial court to decide on the matter of the bestial Sui. The True Lung is set to announce his verdict at the Feast.

prts-75528.text: The Young Chef gives Blaze a special tangerine cake, and Blaze finally puts together the entire truth of her history. Elsewhere, Ning Shu arrives at the Judicial Review Office to have an honest discussion with Yu Cheng in his prison cell about everything to do with an old case from forty years ago.

prts-75529.text: Chaos reigns in the banquet hall, and Xingzhu covers for Blaze as she leaves the scene. Blaze is stopped as she tries to escape, and the one who stops her tells her her true identity: the descendant of the traitorous Grand Preceptor, who committed treason forty years ago.

prts-75532.text: Blaze and Xingzhu finally know each other's histories. Determined to seek an explanation for everyone's sake, Blaze plans to confront the True Lung. Meanwhile, with his delivery box in hand, Young Chef gets ready to meet a very special customer.

prts-75535.text: The bestial Sui matter comes to a head. Atop the Yumen city tower, Liang Xun confesses his actions to the Grand Tutor. Inside an ancient temple outside the city, two proxies reunite after a long time.

prts-75536.text: Blaze and the True Lung finish their long conversation while Yu opens his heart to Wang. With snow falling, the great doors of the Tomb of Sui open again after a hundred and twenty years, and Wang steps inside once more.

prts-75537.text: In far off Lungmen, Wei Yenwu receives an invitation from the capital, prompting him to recall the turbulent tale of how he departed it. Leizi is brought back to the Judicial Review Office, where the minister Chen Che takes pains to dissuade her from chasing down any more of Blaze's history.

prts-75540.text: Grain Buds once heard a story of a talking stockbeast blocking the way, a dark cloud leaping out of a truck, and a passing celestial Xian who helped reunite them. Now she tells this story to the children.

prts-75541.text: After Lin Yühsia returns from Yumen, the Rat King names her his successor. All eyes in Lungmen turn to the slums...

prts-75542.text: Legend tells of an ascended Xian, possibly an elder Tianshi, residing deep in the woods. Wanqing embarks on a journey to seek this sage's advice on challenges in his research.

prts-75543.text: A wintery night in a small inn. A young carpenter is looking to settle his deceased father's debts, while a poor scholar is looking for a meal. Decades later, their paths cross again...

prts-75545.text: Four decades ago, news of the True Lung's death sent shockwaves throughout Yan. One rainy spring night, a prince and a scholar hurried their families out of Baizao.

prts-75546.text: Long ago, a twelfth, nascent consciousness emerged within the Tomb of Sui. This fledgling awareness engaged in conversation with the ancient, immense entity, filled with questions about the vast mortal realm.

prts-76085.text: Loughshinny boards the Duke of Wellington's ship with the Doctor's help, and finally ends the ducal alliance's stalemate siege of the city as Eblana's purple flames spread onto the city walls. Loughshinny keeps her promise and returns to Tara.

prts-76086.text: After the battle at the walls, the defeat of the Sarkaz has led to more chaos in the city. Nowell helps Clovisia, leader of the Self-Salvation Corps, save the innocent citizens. He witnesses her death and lets his obsession go.

prts-76087.text: After the ducal alliance enters the city, Ch'en finally locates Reunion in Londinium, now led by Nine. Reunion saves some innocents affected by the war, and also hears a call to rise up and resist from Ursus.

prts-76088.text: A Rose Riverside's Canoe finds the trail of her missing princess in Londinium, but she does not expect yet another parting waiting for her at its end.

prts-76089.text: The Nachzehrer King makes a final stand at the Palace of Westhaleg. He lets the Doctor's group through to Theresis, and enjoys his last war alone.

prts-76090.text: As the Sarkaz troops withdraw, Catastrophe clouds appear over the capitals of all the Core nations. Amiya stops a fleet that tries to intercept the retreating Sarkaz, and Laterano's main server delivers a revelation about the future.

prts-76446.text: Two survivors are found in the ruins. Brigid entrusts them to Nemos's rescue team, but is shocked when she returns later to find that one of them has been left behind.

prts-76447.text: Kawalerielki's Infected are secretly evacuating for a fourth time, but a little girl has gone missing. Fartooth must find Zola and confront the common question posed to them all: What is home?

prts-76448.text: Justice Knight has a long list of services rendered, but not everyone being served seems happy...

prts-76501.text: After a falling-out with her sister, Loughshinny fails in her attempt to dispel the violet flames. Brigid wants to leave the city and go elsewhere, but gets stuck outside its gates. Dublinn, who should be upholding order in the city, only exacerbates the crisis.

prts-76502.text: Na Saoirsí is caught up in the Samhain celebrations, but Loughshinny senses that something is amiss. A statue, a 'feast', and barely hidden hatred... What she encounters drives her to meet her sister. Both of them look down at the city engulfed in violet flames.

prts-76505.text: Famine breaks out in the city, and hatred for the Victorians is deliberately stoked. Culann tries to distribute stored grain to maintain order, and delegates the task of finding Theo to Nemos. Nemos searches everywhere for Theo to no avail, and eventually runs into Loughshinny.

prts-76506.text: Loughshinny and Brigid search for Theo the apprentice, when they notice something suspicious about the city's grain shop owner. As night falls, Dublinn's victory celebration is about to begin… In the tavern, after another round of drinks, the greedy red dragon of the story makes its return.

prts-76507.text: Driven to madness by avarice, the Dublinners are led into the Dark Woods by the greedy red dragon. From the grain shop owner, Loughshinny and Brigid learn the truth about Theo's disappearance and the whereabouts of the smuggled food carts.

prts-76510.text: Culann drags the sculpture to the city square and tries to make the masses see reason, but dies surrounded by the crowd's madness. Then, purple flames burn, and Eblana descends... The first fragmented story ends here, while the curtains slowly unfurl on the second.

prts-76511.text: The return of the food carts does little to stem the spread of mayhem. Culann learns the truth before Loughshinny and Nemos find him, and makes the decision to destroy the statue in the middle of the square.

prts-76513.text: The statue burns in the square, and invitations to dance—both past and present—overlap as Eblana and Loughshinny face each other, separated by the departed hero in between. In the end, Loughshinny receives an agreement, and takes the deceased out of Na Saoirsí and towards the historical ruins.

prts-76515.text: With the aid of the Exiled King, Loughshinny penetrates the barrier in the Dark Woods and reunites with her companions. In the ruins, the wakemen reject Loughshinny's unspoken words, but accept the request to hold a funeral for the departed.

prts-76519.text: After the funeral, the Exiled King once again appears before Loughshinny, inviting her to witness the secret within the palace ruins for herself. Loughshinny comes face to face with Tara's past, and the story of the Exiled King himself.

prts-76520.text: Eblana welcomes an unexpected guest in the city. In the ruins outside, Loughshinny witnesses a traditional Taran funeral's fire-returning ceremony.

prts-76521.text: Eblana falls, but the purple fire in the city burns even fiercer. Loughshinny, Nemos, and Brigid each take their own action... Here ends the second story.

prts-76525.text: Casualties in the city are heavy. The flames of hatred burn furiously. Loughshinny returns to the city with Brigid. In the ruins, the wakemen and Moran talk about Tara's past. In the tavern, the unnamed woman continues the story.

prts-76526.text: To give the story an ending, the writer begins to tell the third story: Brigid makes a bet with the Exiled King, Loughshinny confronts the dark mist, and Nemos announces the death of the Red Dragon.

prts-76527.text: The curfew is broken by the rising desire to avenge the Red Dragon, until Brigid brings the wakemen back into the city. At the same time, Loughshinny continues to struggle against the dark mist. Amidst sorrow and song, the people begin to return the Red Dragon's flame.

prts-76530.text: As the flames return amidst song, Loughshinny prevails over the dark mist as well as her hesitant heart and enters the purple fire, transforming the purple shade of death into an orange hue of rebirth. From the firelight the red dragon comes back to life, sending the darkness away.

prts-76531.text: In a dilapidated inn, a writer tells a fragmented tale: the greedy red dragon rouses the long-dead Exiled King, while her noble sister leads her companions back to the capital of Tara, Na Saoirsí.

prts-76532.text: The noble red dragon returns to the castle once more. To win many more futures than her own, she goes to confront the greedy red dragon, to kill her, and yet, to mourn her.

prts-76534.text: Here ends the third story. The narration is now complete, and the storytellers revealed. A myth is born, and the nation of Tara rises. The one and only Red Dragon leads her people towards a new life, but her 'shadow' appears at Rhodes Island.

prts-77686.text: The infected Cautus has not died. She's been saved, though she does not know by whom, and taken to a place beyond her comprehension. Three years after the Londinium incident, many operators on Rhodes Island set out to provide reinforcements to various locations.

prts-77687.text: Theresis enters the Assimilated Universe to fight against Originium's will.

prts-77688.text: PRTS is functioning abnormally. Kal'tsit begins preparations for dismantling and preparing Rhodes Island to deal with a threat from the Abyss.

prts-77689.text: Though Kal'tsit strongly disagreed with the approach, she was—as always—willing to honor the plan Amiya and the Doctor put forth, and to offer her protection.

prts-77690.text: Theresis and Ascalon battle atop the collapsed tower.

prts-77691.text: The Doctor and Amiya complete their neural link, and with the help of the Black Crown, they prepare to cross over the boundary of Civilight Eterna. Amiya sees for herself the tale the Doctor once told her. The Cautus Infected spots a mysterious elf out in deep space.

prts-77692.text: While secretly transporting key modules from the ship, Rhodes Island comes under a premeditated attack—but thanks to the Doctor and elite operators, the threat is successfully neutralized.

prts-77693.text: The Cautus Infected learns that the master of the ship she is on is called 'Priestess'. When Amiya crosses the boundary and runs into danger, the Doctor comes to her side. Together, they press onwards, helping each other along the way.

prts-77694.text: The Doctor and Amiya see Priestess in the information stored within the Black Crown. From a fragment of Oracle's experimental records, they obtain the knowledge they seek.

prts-77695.text: The Doctor returns from the Deep Dive and is tested by Kal'tsit for cognitive stability. They begin to utilize the knowledge obtained to Rhodes Island's advantage. In an unknown realm, the Cautus Infected sees the 'God' who saved her.

prts-77702.text: The Doctor, Kal'tsit, and Amiya give it their all as they stand against Priestess.

prts-77703.text: As the group enters the Abyss, Priestess relocates the Doctor, Kal'tsit, and Amiya onto the deck, leaving the rest to fight PRTS's attacks.

prts-77706.text: The Doctor, Kal'tsit, and Amiya give it their all as they stand against Priestess.

prts-77707.text: Amiya manages to draw on the knowledge of the Black Crown to delay Priestess. Communication with the Doctor is restored. The first priority is to overcome the crisis that Priestess and PRTS have brought.

prts-77708.text: The Doctor, Kal'tsit, and Amiya give it their all as they stand against Priestess.

prts-77709.text: The Doctor and Amiya successfully evacuate the ship, which becomes encased in Originium. Mon3tr awakens one month later, but Kal'tsit is no longer by her side.

prts-77710.text: In the final moments of the war, a strong, nameless Infected Cautus walks the battlefield trying to save lives, only to ultimately walk towards a broken ending. Theresis enters the Originium Assimilated Universe.

prts-77712.text: Op Team A4 escorts patients to a temporary location while Rhodes Island is being rebuilt, resulting in conflict with the local population that Adnachiel must resolve.

prts-77713.text: Gavial visits a Sargonian city and learns about a doctor who is offering candy that can treat Oripathy in exchange for blood. She decides to check things out...

prts-77714.text: After a complicated procedure concluded successfully, Kal'tsit finds herself having no choice but to take it easy for a day.

prts-77715.text: Robin finds herself vexed because she hasn't been able to get used to life aboard Rhodes Island. One day, she finds an injured cloudbeast while on a mission...

prts-77716.text: Rhodes Island begins a long rebuilding process, while Mon3tr continues to search for a way to bring Kal'tsit back. The Cautus who should have disintegrated and died returns to Terra, bringing changes beyond her wildest imagination.

prts-78663.text: After causing an explosion in the city, Exusiai enters a confessional and corroborates the strangeness pervading Laterano, as well as the conspiracy to blow up the Shrine of Nurtury and stop the final, most important event of the Summit of Nations—the Nativity.

prts-78664.text: The second Summit of Nations gets underway, welcoming top-level delegations from every Terran nation, from Kazdel to Ægir. However, at a critical moment, an unexpected explosion occurred in Laterano. The newly-created Cardinal Lemuen is assigned to investigate the incident.

prts-78667.text: The 'Matriarch', administrator of the Shrine of Nurtury, demonstrates an all-accommodating future for Laterano to the Gun-Knight Patrizion. Exusiai convinces the firearms workshop's apprentice to help her build explosives.

prts-78669.text: Laterano implements a strict arms control policy, shutting down all its firearms workshops. Exusiai arrives at one of these firearms workshops in search of materials she can use to make explosives. The Shrine of Nurtury continues to take in refugees of all races and nationalities on a large scale.

prts-78672.text: Exusiai is forced to dismantle her bombs when she realizes that the Shrine of Nurtury is full of innocent refugees. During the process, she unexpectedly runs into Lemuen, who is there to investigate. At the same time, Federico finds Arturia, and both of them seem to sense something unusual stirring in Laterano.

prts-78673.text: Arturia escapes her captivity in Landen Monastery, and Federico gives chase. Meanwhile, Exusiai decides to infiltrate the Shrine of Nurtury by blending in with the refugees.

prts-78674.text: Lemuen's investigation of the explosion leads her to the Shrine of Nurtury, but the Matriarch rejects her offer to help with the Shrine of Nurtury's security.

prts-78677.text: Andoain, now working as a Nurturer for the Shrine of Nurtury, is attacked. Fiammetta and her friends save him. Fiammetta decides to drop the matter of Andoain's past actions for the time being, allowing him to complete his duties at the Nativity.

prts-78678.text: 'Fallen' Sanktas outside of Laterano begin to return to the city. Federico and Arturia escape the 'dream' and see a deeply anomalous Laterano.

prts-78679.text: The Matriarch invites Andoain to participate in greater things for the Shrine of Nurtury. Exusiai is arrested for attempting to sabotage the Nativity, and all the non-Sankta are taken away by gun-knights under various pretexts.

prts-78681.text: As Lemuen interrogates Exusiai, a confessional barges onto the scene to save the latter—it turns out the confessional Exusiai has been colluding with is the Doctor. Lemuen decides to let Exusiai go, as the Doctor meets up with Mon3tr to verify the cause of Laterano's various abnormalities.

prts-78682.text: The non-Sankta taken into the Shrine of Nurtury are informed that Laterano will bestow halos on them. Some refuse, but they are not given a choice.

prts-78683.text: Lemuen is defrocked of her cardinal's vestments after letting Exusiai go. Federico and Arturia break free of the 'dream', and realize the Pope has long since vanished. At this moment, Federico receives a mysterious request to enter the city.

prts-78685.text: The arborbeast mother that Andoain has been nursing dies, but his sorrow is soon wiped away. He realizes that the Matriarch has promised him a terrifying future. Federico stands off against the Sanktas errari, eventually permitting them to enter the city to assist him.

prts-78687.text: Andoain, who has come to a sudden revelation, resolves to blow up the very first room in the Shrine of Nurtury. Exusiai, with the Doctor's guidance and the help of the others, takes hold of the Matriarch and pulls her out of the 'dream'.

prts-78688.text: With the guidance of Andoain, Federico and Arturia head underground to search for the Law. Mostima and Fiammetta decide to work separately from Lemuen in their attempts to stop the procession of pilgrims. Meanwhile, Mon3tr and the Doctor get a lock on Priestess's trail.

prts-78689.text: After seeing that the Law's true form is a machine, Arturia decides to leave, while Federico and Andoain step forward for an audience. The rebels place down barrier after barrier. Exusiai tries to attack the First Saint, but the procession of pilgrims seems to be unstoppable.

prts-78692.text: The Law reveals its true nature—a PCS system created by a previous civilization—and thrusts Federico and Andoain into a simulation. The Doctor learns Priestess's true motive for coming to Laterano: to use PCS to unify all the races into one, allowing for the smoother propagation of Originium.

prts-78693.text: The 'dream' collapses, and the masses return to reality. Exusiai finds herself as part of a procession, and the Matriarch, who has reverted to the form of a Teekaz, leads that procession to the Basilica. She tells Exusiai of the origins of Laterano, and that she was the First Saint.

prts-78694.text: More and more people begin to awaken. Patrizion and the others begin to resist. Exusiai manages to defeat the First Saint. PCS reveals its plan, but Federico and Andoain point out its self-contradictory nature, and destroy it.

prts-78696.text: The Nativity is successfully completed. Countless eyes witness an arborbeast give birth to a fledgling with a halo. The Matriarch announces that Laterano will bestow its halo upon all. Federico and Arturia return to reality and find that all of Laterano is under the influence of a 'dream'.

prts-78697.text: The upheaval of faith and the departure of God has left deep scars upon Laterano, as its people struggle to discover new reasons to live and new ways of life. Before the remnant of PCS, Exusiai makes the first wish of a new Laterano.

prts-78698.text: Sanktas living outside Laterano come down with symptoms similar to 'falling' almost simultaneously. The Shrine of Nurtury towers above Laterano, almost touching the clouds. No one remembers when it appeared, but no one questions its existence.

prts-78700.text: The Doctor and Mon3tr verify the issues plaguing Priestess, and refuse her suggestion. Priestess witnesses the birth of a true 'angel prototype' from the remains of PCS. All across Terra, omens of change begin to appear.

prts-78710.text: Friston-3 dreams, despite never having been fitted with the capability to do so by Closure. Popukar wakes up to see unfamiliar figures on the ship's portholes. Something strange is happening to Rhodes Island.

prts-78711.text: Rhodes Island seems to come alive, its internal structure shifting randomly and cutting off all communications. In search of a solution, Kal'tsit enters the Sarcophagus that once held the Doctor, and provides support to the other operators onboard.

prts-78712.text: Priestess shows the information contained within Originium to the Cautus Infected—past events that Priestess witnessed, revealing a glimpse of the threat to civilization.

prts-78715.text: Kal'tsit gets unexpected help in the Sarcophagus. She cuts off her connection with Mon3tr, freeing it, and restoring communications between the operators on the ship, who come together to fight the rampaging PRTS.

prts-78716.text: The Rhodes Island team rescues a weakened Kal'tsit from the Sarcophagus. They prepare to enter the Abyss and face the threat from within Rhodes Island—the core of the rampaging PRTS, and perhaps an awakened Priestess.

prts-78717.text: Friston-3 brings the buggies back under control. The elite operators move to rendezvous with the Doctor. Mission objective: Support Kal'tsit and penetrate the Abyss.

prts-78727.text: Theresis faces Priestess in the Assimilated Universe and wrestles partial control of Originium from her. Badly harmed by the efforts of Theresis and Theresa, Priestess fell into slumber, but now she has awoken.

prts-78730.text: Alanna thought her childhood home was lost to a Catastrophe, but an unexpected violation ticket brings her back home, accompanied by Warmy.

prts-78732.text: Chiave discovers that Broca seems to be distracted lately, shutting himself in his room. He sneaks into Broca's room out of concern, but...

prts-78733.text: Mostima passes through a town where two craftsmen argue about what kind of statue to erect in memory of townsfolk who died in a Catastrophe...

prts-78735.text: An old Ursus man takes a Rhodes Island medic operator hostage, claiming to be an old acquaintance of Nowell's. Saved by the long-lived after losing everything, he claims he can repay the debt.

prts-78736.text: Randall gets a letter from his parents while studying in Leithanien, which turns out to be a practical joke. Someone should teach these amateurs what a REAL practical joke looks like.

prts-79862.text: The producer Greta Stone insists that Dalton's death was an accident, but the coordinator Shelly believes it is linked to an incident five years ago. Lucian is reminded of a lesson that the Troupe Leader gave him when he was young.

prts-79863.text: Lucian has long hypothesized that the Troupe Leader may have returned from the dead. The script being auctioned at Wrankwood, with the Troupe's mark on it, and the accident that occurred after he joined the cast, all seem to indicate that he has come to the right place.

prts-79864.text: Shelly begins to hallucinate on the set, putting herself in danger and rescued by Lucian at the critical moment. Lucian uses the incident as an opportunity to find out more about the accident from five years ago—the tragic death of a young actress named Laura.

prts-79865.text: Shelly leaves a movie viewing session with Tippi, the background painter, after getting a message, and dies in the cold storage section of the warehouse. Lucian sneaks into the office and discovers another deliberately concealed secret.

prts-79866.text: Michael recalls how Laura fell to her death, and wants to escape the plate with Marion. Lucian is increasingly certain that the Troupe Leader is here. He recalls his reasons for escaping the troupe, and once again resolves to kill its leader.

prts-79867.text: Tippi questions Michael, who was the last to see Shelly alive, and suspects him of being the killer. A camera assistant inquires about Lucian's secrets, only to learn that a Catastrophe is about to hit the studio plate.

prts-79868.text: Greta speaks about the accident five years ago, and persuades the film crew to go ahead with the filming of the Catastrophe. Moira corroborates Michael's alibi and tells Tippi and Marion that Michael wanted to sneak off of the plate.

prts-79869.text: Michael and Marion argue while Tippi and Moira reaffirm their friendship. A quiet night passes, but in the morning, the stagehand Hautin discovers the corpses of Michael and Marion on the set, suspended in mid-air.

prts-79870.text: Moira suggests looking for a way to escape. Melanie seeks out Tippi to design the backdrop for her grand finale. While the script's ending is still being written, Greta meets with Lucian, hoping he will become the new leading man. Meanwhile, Steven, struggling with writer's block, hears a knock at his door...

prts-79871.text: Melanie talks about her past rivalry with Marianne, prompting Tippi to decide to help her create the perfect scene. Under the guidance of the 'God of Inspiration', Steven turns Lucian into the savior of his script, and the lead of its grand finale.

prts-79872.text: Greta realizes Lucian is not only focused on the film shoot, but also the things outside of it. She officially invites him to become the 'leading man', and to settle all that has transpired on the plate. His first step is to unmask the killer behind the serial murders—Moira.

prts-79873.text: Lucian reveals every step in Moira's vengeance for her older sister Laura, and as he closes in, Moira discovers she was never a part of Laura's life. The sabotage device Moira installed earlier takes effect, sending the plate straight towards the Catastrophe. The lives of the cast and crew are in grave peril, and there is no turning back.

prts-79874.text: The studio plate is damaged by the Originium storm. Tippi, shocked by the culprit being her good friend, decides to save the plate. At the same time, Lucian finds Moira once more, who has already descended into madness.

prts-79882.text: Lucian defeats the frenzied Moira with the Blood Diamond's song, but in doing so, he too falls into madness. Only through Miss.Christine's calming presence does he regain clarity—and uncover the one behind it all: the leader of the Crimson Troupe, long thought dead.

prts-79883.text: Lucian reveals the true identity of the Troupe Leader: a long-lived known as 'Tragodia'. He kills his teacher, he kills the god. But this murder ends in an inheritance—Lucian becomes the new Tragodia.

prts-79885.text: The Troupe Leader recounts everything that has happened on the plate and expounds on his 'aesthetics of death'. Lucian states his purpose plainly: he's here to kill him—again.

prts-79886.text: It is the last week of shooting for The Death of Lady Dupont, on a Wrankwood studio plate. The Messenger played by Lucian accidentally 'kills' Sir Dupont, but the blood that flows from the actor is not a prop.

prts-79887.text: The murderer's wanton violence sends the film set into a panic. Greta tells everyone of her past and to trust her vision, but disbands the crew—everyone has the right to leave, and she will finish filming with those who want to stay.

prts-79888.text: Tippi visits Moira in prison. 'Lady Dupont' rouses controversy and becomes a film festival's hottest topic. The new Tragodia, Lucian, meets the Playwright and Shalem in a cinema, and they prepare for their new journey.

prts-79890.text: Narantuya finds a golden lamp that marks the location of treasure. It takes great effort and more than a little money for her to reach the destination, but things turn out quite different from what she expected.
